comment: TOOLPAGE-A11Y-1 down-only baseline: generated node pages the accessibility chrome cannot fix. A page listed here must still FAIL the gate; a listed page that now fully passes is itself a red (STALE baseline entry, the ratchet only turns downward). Reasons cite the blocking fact measured at gate time.

entries.art-166-eudr-geolocation-plot-validator: inputSchema properties with no single faithful control (longitude, latitude, area_ha, declared_country, micro_operator_postal_address_provided have no element id on the page) - same composite-input class the WEBMCP-GEN-IDMAP-1 mapping refused; needs a manifest/page mapping row, not a chrome guess.
entries.art-167-eudr-commodity-scope-classifier: inputSchema properties with no element id on the page (employee_count, annual_turnover_eur) - composite-input class; needs a mapping row.
entries.art-175-gpai-code-of-practice-conformanc: 10 inputSchema properties spread composite across checkbox groups (only the provider flag has a faithful single control, already mapped and labeled) - honest exclusion per the IDMAP posture.
entries.art-274-compile-work-mandate: inputSchema properties with no single faithful control (scopeToolIds, conditionsJson, triggersJson composite) - needs a mapping row.
entries.art-124-content-credential-signature-ver: page-only controls signer_public_key_jwk / signed_bytes_b64 / signature_b64 are the CALLER's own verify material, deliberately outside the v1.1.0 tool contract (the kernel input is the attested signature_verified boolean); they carry explicit aria-labels but sit outside the manifest labeling table by design, so the chrome cannot cover them from the manifest.
